definitions.explanation: The black bear of Honshu and Shikoku, named for the white crescent-moon mark on its chest. It often appears in the news when it comes down into villages and towns in autumn looking for food. Also written {月|つき}の{輪熊|わぐま}.

examples.japanese: ツキノワグマ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ツキノワグマ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧。
examples.english: I ran into an Asian black bear on a mountain path.

examples.japanese: ドングリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不作|ふさく}→不作：18799_fusaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ツキノワグマ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{人里|ひとざと}→人里：11477_hitozato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{下|お}りてくること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In years when acorns are scarce, Asian black bears often come down to human settlements in search of food.

notes:
Made of {月|つき}の{輪|わ} (ring of the moon) + ⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧, with ぐま by rendaku. Hikers carry a ⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧⟦よけ→よけ：28839_yoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鈴|すず}→鈴：03890_suzu⟧ (bear bell) to warn bears of their approach.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ツキノワグマ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出没|しゅつぼつ}→出没：28438_shutsubotsu⟧: bear sightings
